text:
jon_support: FYI - AcmePro onboarding blocked. Seeing ~7% 5xx on SSO auth since last night, spike started ~02:10 UTC. CFO mentioned this might impact renewal convo. Escalating to CS for coordinated response.

maria_cs: Ugh. Do we have a root-cause yet? ticket? can we get them a temporary workaround before a call? :eyes:

jon_support: Ticket INC-8842 created. Logs show backend auth proxy returning 500 intermittently. snippet: `POST /auth/sso/token -> 500 (auth0: token exchange failed)` repeated 1.5k times in last 12h. No config changes from customer side.

sanjay_se: I pulled the deployment history — we rolled lib `redwood-auth v2.9.1` yesterday. There's a known regression when a downstream token service returns truncated JSON. Quick mitigation: revert to v2.9.0 or enable `AUTH_STRICT=false` fallback. Can do a rollback within 15m if approved.

emma_csm: Let's not surprise the customer. Plan proposal: 1) short async note to AcmePro saying we're investigating + ETA 30m, 2) offer temporary email auth toggle if they want to continue onboarding, 3) schedule a 30min call in next 60m for joint triage. Volunteers for outreach? :phone: :white_check_mark:

jon_support: I can send the async note now (DM draft below). Also I can open a temporary bypass in the tenant config (email auth) — needs a CSM approval to proceed. Draft: "We’re investigating an intermittent SSO issue impacting new user activation. We’ll provide an update within 30 minutes and a temporary workaround to proceed with onboarding."

maria_cs: I’ll approve the bypass and send calendar invite for 45m from now. Emma, can you lead the call?

emma_csm: I can lead. On the call we’ll: confirm scope, enable workaround if they accept, and share timeline for fix. Also prepare a one-pager for the CFO explaining impact + mitigation.

nick_ops: Ops note — if we rollback to v2.9.0, expect a 3-5 minute deployment window per region, small chance of session invalidation for active logins. If we instead flip `AUTH_STRICT=false` it's config-only and instant for the tenant. Recommend config flip first, then rollback if issues persist. I can execute the flip now.

sanjay_se: Agreed — config flip lowest risk. If we flip, monitor KV cache and token error rate. I’ll watch metrics. Target: error rate <2% within 1 hour.

emma_csm: Comms plan: - Immediate async note by Jon (sent) - Confirm they want email fallback (Maria to enable) - Call in 45m (Emma lead, Jon + Sanjay + Nick on the line) - Exec remediation timeline: config flip now, follow-up rollback if needed.

jon_support: Async note sent to main contact (thread link: https://acmepro.example/threads/8842). I flipped the tenant flag to enable fallback pending Maria's approval.

maria_cs: Approved. Enabled email auth fallback for tenant `acmepro-prod`. Sent invite.

incidentbot: Incident INC-8842 status updated -> triage in progress. Assigned: sanjay_se, nick_ops.

emma_csm: Finalizing handoff doc now with action items + who owns next steps. Action owners: Jon = customer communication, Maria = fallback enable + calendar, Sanjay = metrics/root cause, Nick = ops rollout/rollback. Target checkpoints: 30m update and 4h post-mitigation summary for renewal owner. :rocket:

jon_support: I'll post the 30m update in this thread and include screenshots of metrics.

emma_csm: Thanks team. Keep replies short in this thread so we can forward to stakeholders.
